name: zom-representation
description: Zero-One-Many Representation Evolution — use this skill whenever working with existing code that needs to change, grow, or be refactored. Triggers include: "refactor this", "add a new X to this", "this is getting messy", "how should I represent this", "there's a lot of duplication here", or any time numbered variables, growing conditionals, repeated parameter groups, or scattered constants are observed. Also use proactively when reviewing code for design quality, assessing coherence and development level, or applying the 8 Code Virtues framework. Do not wait to be asked — if you see representation pressure in the code, surface it.
